api.name: sega.log
api.doc: Appends one line to the host log (at most 256 bytes, 16 lines per callback; printable ASCII).

api.name: sega.frame.value
api.doc: Reads one named integer the host published for this frame (a read-only copy; nil when the host publishes no such value).

api.name: sega.overlay.width
api.doc: Width of the HUD overlay in pixels (128).

api.name: sega.overlay.height
api.doc: Height of the HUD overlay in pixels (256).

api.name: sega.overlay.rect
api.signature: (x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number, rgba: number) -> ()
api.doc: Requests a filled rectangle; integers only, clamped to the overlay, rgba is 0xRRGGBBAA, at most 64 requests per callback.

api.name: sega.overlay.text
api.signature: (x: number, y: number, text: string, rgba: number) -> ()
api.doc: Requests text in the host's bitmap font (printable ASCII, at most 64 bytes); the origin is clamped to the overlay.

api.name: sega.overlay.layer
api.signature: (index: number, anchor: string, reference: string, dx: number, dy: number, w: number, h: number, z: number) -> ()
api.doc: Declares positioned overlay layer 1-4 (at most 128 x 128): anchor is top_left, top_center, top_right, middle_left, center, middle_right, bottom_left, bottom_center or bottom_right; reference is picture or presentation (the picture plus the visible widescreen side); dx, dy are added to the anchored position; z 0-3 orders the layers. The host rejects a layer that does not lie wholly inside its reference or exceeds the overlay budget, with a diagnostic; it never moves or clips it.

api.name: sega.overlay.target
api.doc: Selects the layer the following sega.overlay.rect and sega.overlay.text draw into: 0 is the fixed HUD overlay (the default at the start of every callback), 1-4 a layer declared earlier in the same callback.

api.name: sega.sprite.budget
api.doc: Selects the original per-line sprite budget for this frame's virtual sprites ("limit", the default) or an explicit "extended" budget with no per-line limit; over-budget lines are still reported. Presentation only: the game's own sprites and the VDP status are never touched.

api.name: sega.sprite.space
api.doc: Selects the coordinate space of this frame's virtual sprites. Both have the same origin, the top-left pixel of the native picture. "picture" (the default) draws inside the native picture only; "presentation" may also draw into the widescreen columns the viewer actually presents for the current aspect and side style, at x < 0 (left) and x >= 320 (right). A pixel in a column that is not presented is never drawn or counted; a behind_planes or between sprite that reaches a column rejects the whole set (no native priority exists there).

api.name: sega.sprite.tile
api.doc: Writes your OWN pattern pool for mod-authored sprites: 64 hexadecimal digits per 8x8 pattern (4 bits per pixel, the VDP layout), consecutive patterns from `index` (0-2047). The pool is yours and one frame long; it never touches VRAM.

api.name: sega.sprite.palette
api.doc: Writes your OWN palette line 0-3 for mod-authored sprites: 4 hexadecimal digits per colour (the VDP 0BGR word), at most 16 colours.

api.name: sega.sprite.add
api.signature: (provenance: string, layer: string, x: number, y: number, width_cells: number, height_cells: number, tile: number, palette: number, flags: number) -> ()
api.doc: Adds one virtual sprite for this frame: provenance "authored" (your own pool) or "verified" (the game's art in the frame's VRAM/CRAM; the host rejects the whole set unless it established a verified, exactly current snapshot); layer "behind_planes", "between" or "above_all" against the native priority classes; x, y are the top-left picture pixel; 1-4 cells wide and high; flags bit 0 horizontal flip, bit 1 vertical flip. At most 64 per frame; a larger set, or any invalid command, is rejected as a whole with a stable reason and nothing is drawn.

api.name: sega.sprite.clip
api.signature: (x: number, y: number, width: number, height: number) -> ()
api.doc: Clips the most recently added sprite to a rectangle of picture pixels.

api.name: sega.scene
api.doc: Names the scene this frame belongs to (a token [a-z0-9_-], at most 32 characters; the last call wins). The host uses it only to count what was delivered per scene against the package's declared geometry; it is a claim, never inferred, and grants nothing.

api.name: sega.mem.read
api.signature: (space: string, offset: number, width: number) -> number
api.doc: Reads 1, 2 or 4 bytes (big-endian) of a declared work-RAM range; the space is named ("m68k.work_ram"); sees this callback's own staged writes; a violation is a fault.

api.name: sega.mem.write
api.signature: (space: string, offset: number, width: number, value: number) -> ()
api.doc: Stages a 1, 2 or 4 byte big-endian write to a declared work-RAM range; committed atomically when the callback returns without a fault (at most 1024 writes, 16384 bytes); a violation is a fault.

api.name: sega.input.get
api.doc: Reads the pad (button bits) of port 1 or 2: the previous frame's final input in frame-begin, the sample (with your staged change) in input, the final input in post-input.

api.name: sega.input.set
api.doc: Replaces the pad (button bits 0-255) the guest will read this frame; only in input; a violation is a fault.

api.name: reset
api.doc: Optional. Called once before the first frame.

api.name: frame_begin
api.doc: Optional. Called at the start of each guest frame, before its input sample.

api.name: input
api.doc: Optional. Called after the pad was sampled for the frame and before the guest can read it.

api.name: post_input
api.doc: Optional. Called after the input phase, before the guest runs the frame.

api.name: frame_end
api.doc: Optional. Called when the guest finished the frame, before its render snapshot.

api.name: render
api.doc: Optional. Called once per frame after its snapshot; `frame` is the frame counter.
